summary: Iteration 2 retest. All requested items pass. Backend: 30/30 pytest pass, including the new tests for overlay src validation (youtube/vimeo host check, media prefix), media byte-sniff rejection, the nosniff header (200 and 206), the overlong key giving is_owner=false, and soft delete making the book's page/thumb files return 404. Frontend: viewer next/prev buttons and arrow keys work at 1920x1080 and 1100x1080 (1 -> 2-3 -> 4-5 -> 6 and back) and at 390x844 in portrait (1..6 and back). The thumbnails sheet updates the counter correctly (thumb-4 gives 4-5/6 on desktop and 5/6 on mobile), and next after a thumb jump continues correctly. The mobile toolbar is 345px wide inside 390, the zoom buttons are hidden and there is no horizontal overflow. Editor regression passed: adding a link and a picture (upload 200) and saving (PUT 200) persisted both and stayed on /edit with no unsaved indicator.

minor.issue: If a book is deleted while convert_job is still running, pages stored after the delete get new db.files records with is_deleted=False, so they stay publicly served. Check is_deleted inside convert_job, or mark files deleted at the end of the job.
Image/video overlay src only checks the 'flipcraft/media/' prefix and not that the media belongs to the same owner, so another owner's media path can be referenced. Low risk.

issues: H input shows an unrounded float (e.g. 18.8440221). Round it to 1-2 decimals.

action_items: Optional: stop convert_job from creating live file records for books deleted mid-conversion
Optional: round the X/Y/W/H values shown in the editor properties panel
critical_code_review_comments: FlipBook.turn() temporarily toggles settings.disableFlipByClick. This works but depends on page-flip internals. Note it in a comment, or guard with try/finally.
get_flipbook is_owner check is now safe for malformed keys (length is checked before owner_hash).
